shortBulletSummary: Crypto markets plunged, with Bitcoin falling below $62K, ETH down 6%, and over $700M in liquidations.
Extreme fear grips crypto markets as the Fear & Greed Index drops to 20-23 amid significant market declines.
Fears of Fed rate hikes are growing, with Bank of America predicting three hikes, which is expected to strengthen the USD.
US-Iran tensions are fueling market volatility, with mixed signals on peace talks adding to overall uncertainty.
Trump's Quantum Executive Order is seen as a potential threat to blockchain technology, impacting crypto.
